Aisha: quick question — our IC who's about to start PTO for parental bonding wants to bring forward two weeks of paid onboarding to cover childcare overlap. theyre international relocating and start date is next Monday. any special process?

Matt: if they havent hit their 90-day eligibility for company parental pay we cant change statutory rules, but we do have a temporary onboarding childcare stipend for relocations. details: one-time up to $3k, manager approval + receipts, processed as an onboarding expense.

Aisha: manager (Taylor) approves. candidate would need funds upfront to book caregiver and travel — do we do advances here or reimbursements only?

Taylor: approve advance in principle. prefer advance as candidate is booking tonight. Taylor will sign conditional agreement.

People Ops Bot: New HR case HR-2026-558 created by Aisha. Status: intake -> awaiting manager approval upload. Link: https://redwoodinternal/hr/cases/HR-2026-558

Matt: process steps: 1) upload signed conditional advance (CL-ONB) 2) attach brief justification and travel dates 3) finance issues one-time advance to payroll. Note: recovery if the hire fails to start within 30 days.

Aisha: uploaded docs and conditional agreement. requested expedited review.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: Onboarding Childcare Stipend (code: ONB-ADV), max $3,000, approval flow Manager -> People Ops -> Finance. Repayment 100% if no-show within 30 days.

Matt: triaging now, aiming for same-day decision.

Aisha: thanks — candidate booked provisional caregiver and will send receipts after purchase. will post final here.
